Notably local.properties already points to /opt/flutter - interesting, perhaps the environment prepared that. So the intended Flutter location is /opt/flutter. Good.

Now the app is Android/iOS only (no linux/web). To do a meaningful verification, we could try building the Android APK. But that needs Android SDK. The guide says Android toolchain and Android Studio required. We could install Android command line tools and build. Let's attempt: install Android SDK cmdline-tools, platform 34/35, build-tools, set up. Then `flutter build apk --flavor ni --dart-define=PARTNER=ni`.

That is heavy but feasible and gives strong verification. Let's first check if there's a build.gradle referencing keys / google-services requiring secrets.

Let me look at the rest of build.gradle and assets/keys.
